requirements: R1: Synchronize internal task status with GitHub reality for PRs closed without merge
R2: Remove active masking and hardcoded stubs that cause fraudulent reports

slices.title: Patch GitHub status synchronization and remove hardcoded stubs
slices.jtbd: When implementing the status synchronization for this epic, I want to remove hardcoded stubs and enforce atomic status updates, so that tasks accurately reflect their GitHub PR state without false success reports.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task whose corresponding PR is closed without merge on GitHub with no hardcoded stubs present
When the system synchronizes the task status using actual GitHub synchronization logic
Then the internal task status accurately reflects the closed state via an atomically-guarded database update with full test coverage
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce task status synchronization mismatch rate to 0%
